text:
Which statement about fuels is correct?
A
Coal and ethanol are examples of non-renewable energy sources.
B
Hydrogen and oxygen can be reacted to produce an electric current.
C
Large amounts of energy are taken in by a fuel when it burns.
D
Radioactive isotopes are burned to produce heat.

options.label: A
options.text: Coal and ethanol are examples of non-renewable energy sources.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrogen and oxygen can be reacted to produce an electric current.

options.label: C
options.text: Large amounts of energy are taken in by a fuel when it burns.

options.label: D
options.text: Radioactive isotopes are burned to produce heat.
